profile.headline: DFSMS Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a DFSMS (Data Facility Storage Management Subsystem) Level 2 Engineer, I focus particularly on device services, my responsibilities focus on managing, troubleshooting and optimizing devices within the storage subsystem.

positions.title: Remote Code Load Engineer
positions.description: In my position as Remote Code Load Engineer, my main responsibility is to keep several IBM systems up to date, which are within the field of Storage Systems. Among them we can mention the DS8800 Products, TS7700 Products, and FlashSystem Products. In this position I must maintain good communication with the clients during hardware troubleshooting time. I have also helped my team with some tools that have made it possible to streamline some processes. Currently I work as a shift coordinator where I can help my team from the point of view of avoiding bottlenecks and working in those cases where greater attention is required to guarantee the best quality service to the customers.

positions.title: Noc. Operator
positions.description: As a Noc Operator my responsibility is to carry out monitoring operations, servicing servers, network and telecommunication equipment in several organizations. In addition, I monitor the network infrastructure, servers, and computer networks for issues from a centralized location.

positions.title: Computer network analyst
positions.locationName: Street 23 No. 258 between L and M. Vedado. Ciudad La Habana. Cuba. CP: 10400.
positions.description: As a network administrator I was responsible for maintaining computer networks and solving any problems that may occur with them. I also had to install and configure computer networks and systems, monitor computer networks and systems to identify how performance can be improved

company.name: Cuban Institute of Radio and Television

educations.schoolName: Universidad Tecnológica de La Habana "José Antonio Echeverría"​, CUJAE
